player_prompt.intro:
Ozali Joueur {player_id} ({role}) na mokili ya Matching Pennies ya {num_rounds} mikolo.
- Na kila mokolo, kotiya [heads] to [tails] (to [h], [t]).
- Soki bino na bana bino balingani, Joueur 0 akoki mokolo; soki nde balingani te, Joueur 1 akoki.
Yiba na bino bino na formati '[heads]' to '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Jokali 0 akómaka {choice0}; Jokali 1 akómaka {choice1}. Match -> Jokali 0 azóngaka
message.round_mismatch: Jokali 0 akómaka {choice0}; Jokali 1 akómaka {choice1}. Mismatch -> Jokali 1 azóngaka.

outcome.draw: Na mobimba, lisano yango ezali na molɔngɔ te.
